 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 21, 2026, 03:04 IST Updated: Oct 21, 2026, 03:04 IST school holiday Schools in several parts of India may remain closed on Wednesday due to the ongoing Dussehra and Durga Puja holidays. While Dussehra or Vijayadashami was observed on October 20 in most parts of India, schools in West Bengal and some other regions may continue their festive break on October 21.
 The school holiday schedule varies by state, district and institution. Some schools are following extended autumn or Durga Puja vacations, while others may reopen after the main Dussehra holiday. Students and parents should check their school's latest notice to confirm whether classes will resume today.
 With October coming to an end, students are also looking for the November 2026 school holiday list. The month includes Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. 
 However, not all these festivals will result in school closures across the country.
 School Holiday on October 21, 2026: State-Wise Updates 
 Here is a state-wise overview of the reported school holiday situation on October 21.
 State/Region School Holiday Status 
 West Bengal Schools following the Durga Puja vacation may remain closed for Vijayadashami. 
 Haryana Schools are scheduled to remain closed during the extended Dussehra break. 
 Andhra Pradesh Dasara vacation continues through October 21; reopening is expected on October 22. 
 Telangana Students should check the school reopening notice following the Dasara vacation. 
 Delhi-NCR The main Dussehra holiday was on October 20; reopening depends on the school's calendar. 
 Uttar Pradesh School closures depend on the local holiday schedule and institution. 
 Maharashtra The October 21 holiday status varies by school. 
 Karnataka Students should check the school's Dasara vacation and reopening dates. 
 These updates are based on published reports and may not apply to every school in a state. Government, private, CBSE and ICSE schools can follow different academic calendars.
 School Holiday List for the Rest of October 2026 
 Students may get additional holidays during the final days of October because of weekends and regional festivals. 
 The following dates may be relevant when planning the rest of the month.
 Date Day Occasion 
 October 21 Wednesday Vijayadashami in West Bengal; regional holiday 
 October 24 Saturday Weekend holiday for schools following a Saturday break 
 October 25 Sunday Weekly holiday 
 October 26 Monday Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti; regional holiday 
 October 29 Thursday Karwa Chauth; restricted or regional holiday in some places 
 October 31 Saturday Weekend holiday for schools following a Saturday break 
 Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti and Karwa Chauth are not universal school holidays. Whether schools close on these dates depends on the state government's holiday list and the school's academic calendar.
 November 2026 School Holiday List: Check Important Dates 
 November 2026 will bring several religious and regional festivals that may lead to school holidays. Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, while Govardhan Puja is observed on November 9 and Bhai Dooj on November 11.
 Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti will also be observed during the month. Their impact on school schedules will depend on state-level notifications and local traditions.
 Date Day Festival or Occasion 
 November 8 Sunday Diwali or Deepavali 
 November 9 Monday Govardhan Puja 
 November 11 Wednesday Bhai Dooj 
 November 15 Sunday Chhath Puja 
 November 24 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti 
 Note: The table lists important festival dates, not guaranteed school closures. Some schools may observe additional holidays before or after a festival, while others may remain open on certain regional occasions.
 1. Diwali School Holiday 2026 
 Diwali, also known as Deepavali, falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026. 
 It is one of India's major festivals and is celebrated with lights, diyas, decorations and family gatherings.
 Since Diwali falls on a Sunday, schools that already remain closed on Sundays will not receive an additional weekday holiday for the festival itself. However, some schools may announce an extended Diwali break around the festival.
 2. Govardhan Puja Holiday 2026 
 Govardhan Puja will be observed on Monday, November 9, 2026. The festival is celebrated in several parts of India, particularly in northern states.
 Schools in regions where Govardhan Puja is an official holiday may remain closed. Students should check the state holiday calendar or their school's notice for confirmation.
 3. Bhai Dooj School Holiday 2026 
 Bhai Dooj falls on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The festival celebrates the bond between brothers and sisters and is observed after Diwali.
 Some schools may declare a holiday for Bhai Dooj, especially in states where it is included in the official holiday calendar. 
 However, the closure is not uniform across India.
 4. Chhath Puja Holiday 2026 
 Chhath Puja is scheduled for Sunday, November 15, 2026. The festival is widely celebrated in Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh and parts of other states.
 Because Chhath Puja is an important regional festival, schools in some areas may observe additional holidays around the occasion. The exact dates will depend on local government notifications and school schedules.
 5. Guru Nanak Jayanti School Holiday 2026 
 Guru Nanak Jayanti, also known as Gurpurab, falls on Tuesday, November 24, 2026. The festival marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the founder of Sikhism.
 It is listed as a major public holiday in the central government's 2026 holiday calendar. Schools in several states may remain closed, although the applicable holiday arrangements should be confirmed locally.
